tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms & conditions as per Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Proof of experience in the relevant field minimum 5 years compulsory
GST Registration Certificate along with GST Clearance Certificate / GSTR-3B for the last three financial years
Details of supplies made during the last 5 years to National/State Government Institutions and other reputed institutions
Acceptance Letter agreeing to abide by all terms and conditions of the Tender, executed on Rs.100/- Bond Paper

List of full particulars, available sources and current prices of spare parts, special tools and other items required for proper and continuous functioning of the equipment for 3 years warranty and 5 years CMC after the warranty period
Manufacturers Authorization / Authorized Dealer Certificate where the Tenderer is offering equipment not manufactured or produced by the Tenderer

Average Annual Turnover for FY 2022 23, 2023 24 and 2024 25 not less than the Tendered Value, duly certified by a Chartered Accountant with seal, signature and UDIN Number. Certificates without UDIN will be treated as disqualified
